result.quote: I wholly dedicate the silver to the LORD for my son’s benefit, to make a graven image and a molten idol.
result.reason: The key is supported as a general description of the purpose, but “For what” is ambiguous: the verse also says the silver is dedicated “to the LORD” and “for my son’s benefit.” Ask “What does Micah’s mother dedicate the silver to make?” to uniquely target the image and idol.
